board_game.name: Board Game
must_have: 2 to 4 player support with human and smart AI computer opponent
Animated interactive dice / turn indicator with roll physics
Exact board rules: safe squares, capture mechanics, home stretch, exact roll to win
Turn timer, current player highlight with colored tokens
Win modal with confetti/particles, winner podium, and restart option
Sound effects toggle (using Web Audio API synthesizers)
How to play / Rules bottom sheet or tab
Persistent match stats and win history in localStorage

arcade_game.name: Arcade Game
must_have: Responsive 60fps canvas / css transform game loop
Touch controls (swipe, tap buttons, on-screen d-pad)
Score tracker and persistent local high score
Pause / Resume overlay with sound mute toggle
Increasing difficulty / speed levels with visual feedback
Game over screen with instant restart
Haptic feedback on crash / point scored via navigator.vibrate

quiz_trivia.name: Quiz & Trivia
must_have: Categorized question banks with multiple difficulty levels
Interactive option buttons with instant correct/incorrect visual feedback
Countdown timer per question with warning color state
Score tally, streak multiplier, and progress bar
Detailed summary screen with answer review and explanations
Persistent score history and personal best

finance_tracker.name: Finance & Expense Tracker
must_have: Income, expense, and transfer transaction logging with categories
Visual balance cards (Total Balance, Monthly Income, Monthly Expense)
Interactive SVG/Canvas category spending breakdown and charts
Transaction list with search, category filtering, and date range
Currency selector (INR ₹, USD $, EUR €)
Budget limit progress bars with warning alerts
CSV export and full persistent local storage with backup

productivity_todo.name: Productivity & Habits
must_have: Task creation with title, priority (High/Med/Low), tags, and due dates
Streak tracking calendar/grid for habits
Filter by status (All, Active, Completed, Overdue)
Swipe to delete or complete with undo toast
Search bar with live filtering
Statistics / completion rate graphs
LocalStorage persistence with error-resilient wrapper

ecommerce_store.name: E-Commerce & Food Ordering
must_have: Product catalog with categories, search, price sorting, and rating filters
Product detail modal with image gallery, quantity selector, and description
Persistent shopping cart with quantity adjustments and item removal
Order checkout wizard with address, delivery notes, and payment mode mockup
Discount promo code input with calculation
Order status tracking screen (Placed -> Preparing -> Delivered)

fitness_health.name: Fitness & Health Tracker
must_have: Daily goal circles (Water, Calories, Workout time, Steps)
Interactive exercise logger with sets, reps, and weights
Rest timer with audio beep on completion
BMI and calorie calculation tools
Weekly progress SVG charts
Streak tracking and motivational achievements

utilities_tools.name: Utility & Tool
must_have: High precision calculation engine with history tape
Clean keypad with haptic press micro-interactions
Conversion matrix across units (length, weight, temp, currency)
Copy result to clipboard with toast confirmation
Theme toggle (Dark / Light / OLED black)
Instant offline availability
